contract.purpose: Display passive startup status and expose slow or failure state without owning, routing, repairing, or persisting startup.

BOOTING: App Orchestrator script presence before acknowledgement
BOOT_SLOW: elapsed observation time beyond the bounded slow threshold while startup remains incomplete
READY_ACKNOWLEDGED: existing App Orchestrator acknowledgement or current report in the current-app document context

contract.fail_passive: If an input is absent, inaccessible, malformed, or cross-context blocked, show an unknown or failure observation without changing route, repairing startup, taking ownership, or writing storage.

selected_boundary.observation_point: Within the current-app inner document, after the existing pmp-app-orchestrator-v1.js load/acknowledgement opportunity and before any Boot Status Strip rendering or interaction.
selected_boundary.reason: This is the narrowest boundary that can observe App Orchestrator acknowledgement and current startup state without changing Route Guardian, reload-owner routing, App Orchestrator ownership, or startup progression.

claim_ceiling: Current-path passive contract and consumer-boundary selection only. No runtime integration, live visibility, Pass 4 completion, Pass 5 work, or broad production correctness is claimed.
